narrative.details:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
narrative.objectives: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her. Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.
